context_for_next_testing_agent: Slide-to-Video improvements backend fully tested and passing. New endpoints: POST /api/heygen/render-slide/{project_id}/{slide_index} (renders slide as PNG), POST /api/heygen/render-all-slides/{project_id} with selectedIndices, POST /api/heygen/generate-all-slide-scripts with selectedIndices body. Frontend 3-step wizard (Avatar&Voz > Scripts > Gerar) has correct UI structure but avatar/voice grids don't populate - investigate React state issue with heygenAvatars/heygenVoices.

render_slide.details: POST /api/heygen/render-slide/{project_id}/{slide_index} renders slide as PNG (1280x720) using PIL/Pillow. Returns url, width, height, slide_index. Handles invalid project/index with 404.

render_all_slides.details: POST /api/heygen/render-all-slides/{project_id} accepts selectedIndices body parameter to selectively render slides.

generate_scripts_with_selected.details: POST /api/heygen/generate-all-slide-scripts now accepts JSON body with selectedIndices to generate scripts only for checked slides.

avatar_gender_filter.details: GET /api/heygen/avatars?gender=male|female filters correctly. Returns available_genders array.

voice_filters.details: GET /api/heygen/voices supports language and gender filters. Combined filters work (e.g., ?language=portuguese&gender=female).

3_step_wizard.details: Step indicator (1-2-3) navigation works. Step 1 UI has avatar search, gender filters, voice language dropdown, gender filters - but avatar/voice grids empty. Step 2 has slide list, checkboxes, 'Gerar Scripts com IA' button, 'Selecionar todos'/'Desmarcar todos' links. Step 3 has summary with slide count, avatar/voice names, validation warnings.

api_endpoints_tested.GET /api/heygen/avatars: PASS - Returns avatars with preview_image_url, gender filter works

rca_of_the_issue: Frontend avatar/voice grid not populating: The loadHeygenData() function in Editor.jsx line 1354 calls the API correctly, but the React state (heygenAvatars, heygenVoices) doesn't populate the UI grid in the SlideVideoDialog. Possible causes: 1) State update timing issue with Promise.all, 2) Dialog re-render not triggering after state update, 3) The grid uses different filter variables (avatarGenderFilter vs heygenAvatarGenderFilter). The API returns valid data - verified with curl.
